title: Se corta la llamada
setting: Emma te llama desde el tren a Dublín. La cobertura va y viene.

says.t: Hi Yolanda! It's Emma. Can you hear me?

options.t: Hi Emma! Not very well. You're breaking up.
options.es: ¡Hola, Emma! No muy bien. Se corta.

options.t: Hi Emma! Not very good. You're breaking up.
options.es: ¡Hola, Emma! No muy bien. Se corta.
options.feedback: Cómo la oyes: adverbio. Not very well.

options.t: Hi Emma! I can't listen you.
options.feedback: Oír = hear: I can't hear you.

says.t: Sorry! I'm on the train. The signal is terrible.
says.es: ¡Perdona! Voy en el tren. La cobertura es malísima.

options.t: Could you speak a bit more loudly?
Could you speak a bit more loud?
options.feedback: Cómo habla: adverbio, more loudly (o speak up).

says.t: Is this better? I'm going to Dublin for the weekend!
says.es: ¿Mejor así? ¡Me voy a Dublín el fin de semana!

options.t: How lovely! Could you send me some photos?
How lovely! Could you sending me some photos?
options.feedback: Could you + verbo sin -ing: Could you send…?

says.t: Of course! Oh no, my battery is low.
says.es: ¡Claro! Ay, no, me queda poca batería.

options.t: Don't worry. Could you call me back later?
Don't worry. Could you call to me later?

options.t: Don't worry. Hang up me later.
options.feedback: Hang up es colgar. Para que te llame: Could you call me back later?

says.t: Yes, tonight from the hotel. Is nine OK?
says.es: Sí, esta noche desde el hotel. ¿Te va bien a las nueve?

options.t: Perfect. Text me when you arrive, please.
options.es: Perfecto. Escríbeme cuando llegues, por favor.

options.t: Perfect. Text to me when you arrive, please.
